what: the exact requests one real MCP client sends on connect
captured: a tee wrapper around `interjson mcp`, added with `claude mcp add`
why: The audit asked for at least one mandatory host integration verified against a real client session (marks/迭代.md §8.3). The client's own handshake is the part that can be replayed; it is recorded verbatim so a regression in the envelope, the revision negotiation or the discovery probe shows up as a failing replay rather than as a client that silently refuses to connect.
notes: The client sends `server/discover` BEFORE `initialize`, with a newer revision (2026-07-28) in `_meta`. A server that answers that probe with -32002 'not initialized' is answering a question that needs no session with an error.
The client asks for revision 2025-11-25 and this server negotiates down to 2025-06-18, which the client accepts.
